title: Lyn Alden: Debt System ‘Is Breaking’—How High Will Yields Go?
speaker: Lyn Alden

macro_themes.view: US is slowly taking on emerging-market traits: persistent above-target inflation, Fed buying bonds with inflation above target; 'nothing stops that train'.

Long end is repricing to a higher-for-longer reality, not 'lost control'; curve still flat; 6% 10y would not be unusual but is not her base case; heavy media attention suggests the bulk of the move may be done.
Housing and small businesses squeezed; cash holders and AI/defence/healthcare beneficiaries gain; higher short rates are stimulative for cash-rich entities.
Multi-year bear market of stocks priced in gold despite dollar gains.
Altcoins past their 2021 high-water mark; Bitcoin and stablecoins can grow much larger.
AI can run longer than people think; she won't short major assets; hyperscalers burning FCF, frontier labs unprofitable.

calls.reason: Yields 'realistically should be kind of at where they are now or a little higher'; 6% possible within normal curve shape but not base case; sentiment says much of the move is done.
calls.quote: realistically bond yields should be kind of at where they are now or a little higher

calls.reason: Excludes Bitcoin from 'crypto is dead'; expects it to grow much larger amid fiscal dominance and debasement.
calls.quote: Now I I think Bitcoin uh can go much larger than it is now.

calls.reason: On average somewhat bullish on profitable semiconductor companies but cautious after very fast moves.
calls.quote: on average I've been somewhat bullish on semiconductors. I just get cautious you know when they when they've had a very fast move.

calls.reason: Trimmed out after it more than doubled while turning free-cash-flow negative; bullish thesis played out, not acutely bearish.
calls.quote: I eventually trimmed out of that. Uh, not say that I'm acutely bearish, but I just my bullish thesis has kind of played out.

notes: Host states 'This is Friday, October 2nd' (listing approx 10-04); weak jobs report day, so recorded intraday. TNX level not quoted (described as 20-year highs; other sources ~5%). She explicitly says she is not a trader and has no 3-6 month view on yields. Altcoin bearishness not tied to a named ticker; SpaceX/AI labs mentioned only as things she avoids.
